text: A year after a car crash kills her husband Paul and daughter Jessica, Sarah, [still raw with grief|who_suffers|the grieving], joins five friends to explore a cave in the Appalachian Mountains of North Carolina. When a tunnel collapses behind them, Juno admits she has led them into [an unmapped system no rescue party could find|trigger|cut off and trapped]. Deep in the dark live pale, blind creatures that [hunt by sound|rules|how it hunts], and as the women scatter, a pendant tells Sarah [what Juno kept from her|wrong|love betrayed].
